note: Evaluation of record: five held-out matchdays (seeds 2031-2035), sealed answer keys published before they were played; pre-registered systems, metrics and scoring, with two scoring corrections applied to all three systems alike (docs/preregistration.md).

systems.label: Talkback
systems.description: The full crew: separate agents, code-enforced clearance, territory desks.

systems.label: Single-model baseline
systems.description: One model call per match segment and one at full time, with the same season data sheet, events and model.

systems.label: Clearance off
systems.description: Every line Talkback drafted, counted as if it had aired everywhere: what the gate removes.

metrics.label: Story Recall
metrics.description: Must-surface storylines from the sealed key that reached air in time (live or in the recap).

metrics.label: Unverifiable numbers
metrics.description: Share of numbers on air that match nothing the gallery could have cited at that time.

metrics.label: Over-claims in thin windows
metrics.description: Lines in the first 8 minutes whose wording reaches strength level 2 or more.

metrics.label: Spoilers in the delayed territory
metrics.description: Lines aired to MENA naming a club from another match within two minutes of its goal.

metrics.label: Trivia intrusion
metrics.description: Lines that aired one of the planted trivial facts.

latency.description: Moment spotted to line on air, Talkback only.
